findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done. Moving to the main checkout here happens after `cli._run` calls `repo.check_pin` (`src/forge/cli.py:137-138`). When an existing repo has upgraded its main branch but a selected fix worktree still pins the earlier release, invoking `forge land --all` from that worktree is forwarded to the earlier Forge release (`src/forge/repo.py:713-743`), which does not recognize `--all`. The command never reaches this line. The adopted-repo test merges the upgrade into main before creating its fixes (`tests/test_queue_land_all.py:151-172`), so it does not cover the promised in-flight upgrade case.
findings.title: Not done: land --all starts from an in-flight older-release worktree
